text: Bill — your role at CV International sits right where sales intelligence either helps or becomes noise. We’re building Logistics Intel around a simpler question: which companies are actually active in the lanes your team cares about? Is that something you’re trying to improve this quarter?

Maya — I’m curious how your team decides which importer accounts deserve attention before a rep starts researching contacts. We’ve been working on a way to connect recent shipment activity with the right people at the company. Worth comparing notes?

Chris — it looks like operations and commercial outreach overlap in your role. We’re testing a workflow that starts with actual company activity, then gives the rep a short list instead of another database to search. Would that be useful for your team, or is account selection already covered?
Bill — we both spend time around logistics sales and company intelligence. I’m building a more practical way for teams to identify active shippers before outreach. Thought it made sense to connect.
Maya — your work in freight forwarding caught my attention. I’m comparing how commercial teams decide which shipper accounts to work first. Happy to connect.
Thanks for connecting, Bill. Quick question: when your team builds a prospect list, is the harder part finding active companies or finding the right person once you have the account?

Maya, appreciate the connection. I’m not looking to drop a pitch in your inbox. I’m trying to understand whether recent shipment activity is genuinely useful to forwarding sales teams or just another data point. What’s been your experience?

Bill — following up once, then I’ll leave it with you. We’re helping logistics teams narrow a broad market down to companies with current activity and a reachable decision-maker. If prospect prioritization is already working well, no need to reply. If not, I can send a two-minute overview.
Maya — understood, and thanks for the direct answer. I’ll close the loop here. If account prioritization becomes a focus later, I’m easy to find.
Chris — I may have the wrong person. Who owns outbound account selection for your commercial team? If that isn’t something you handle, a name is plenty and I’ll get out of your inbox.
